entities.summary: Johann Gottfried Olearius (1635–1711) was a German preacher, musician and horticulturalist. He was the superintendent and pastor of the Barfüsserkirche. He had been an accomplished church musician and supervised the young Johann Sebastian Bach when he was a church organist at Arnstadt from 1703 to 1707. Olearius also had an interest in horticulture, and the plant genus Olearia was named in his honour by Conrad Moench.
